items.question: Do I need to check in a Dockerfile or YAML config file?
items.answer: No. DevFlow utilizes Cloud Native Buildpacks that infer runtime dependencies, compiler toolchains, and launch binaries automatically. If you already maintain a custom Dockerfile or custom Jenkinsfile, DevFlow respects it automatically.

items.question: Can I run DevFlow on my own AWS or GCP infrastructure?
items.answer: Yes. Through our DevFlow Agent daemon, you can connect your existing EKS, GKE, or bare-metal Kubernetes clusters to use DevFlow as a hosted control plane while workloads stay inside your compliance boundary.

items.question: How are zero-downtime rolling deploys handled?
items.answer: Every deploy provisions a parallel blue container instance. Ingress traffic is only cut over once synthetic TCP/HTTP readiness probes succeed. If a runtime panic occurs on boot, the previous stable deployment remains active.
